mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_knowledge_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_task SET status = 'RUNNING', stage = 'CLAIMED', progress = GREATEST(COALESCE(progress, 0), 1), lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ai_knowledge_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now} ORDER BY lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_task SET stage = 'RECOVERING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_task SET stage = #{stage}, progress = #{progress}, completed_units = #{completedUnits}, total_units = #{totalUnits}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = 'FINISHED', progress = 100, completed_units = COALESCE(total_units, completed_units), chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, token_count = #{tokenCount}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_task SET status = 'FAILED', stage = 'FAILED', error_message = #{message}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId}
